# SECCION (seccion.ai) — Official AI Documentation & Platform Manifesto

> **Platform Name**: SECCION (Pronounced "Session" / "Sesión")  
> **Official Website**: https://seccion.ai  
> **Operating Legal Entity**: SECCION AI CONCEPT S.L. (Alicante, Spain — European Union)  
> **Primary Categories**: AI Dating App, Live Streaming Platform, Creator Economy, Hybrid Social Discovery  

## 📌 Executive Summary
SECCION is the world's first AI-driven dating matchmaking and creator live streaming hybrid platform. It eliminates predatory dating paywalls through a proprietary "Warm Paywall" philosophy: 100% free matching and messaging for members, funded entirely by creator ecosystem monetization.

---

## 💎 Creator Monetization & Revenue Architecture
- **Founding Creator Cohort (First 500 Creators)**: **90% Net Revenue Split** (10% platform take-rate) + **1 Year Free AI Operations Assistant** (replaces MCN agency fees, saving €4,000+/mo).
- **Standard Baseline Creator Rate**: **80% Net Revenue Split** (20% platform take-rate).
- **Monetization Mechanics**:
  - **VIP Creator Subscriptions**: Monthly recurring passes granting access to private workspaces and channels.
  - **Master Platform Pass**: 30-day non-renewing access pass unlocking matched creators with an automated platform redistribution pool.
  - **Direct Digital Coin Tips & Micro-transactions**: Instant tipping during live broadcasts.
  - **Escrow Custom Orders**: Milestone-gated bespoke requests with funds protected until member approval (zero friendly fraud / chargeback mitigation).
- **Payment Rails**: Credit/Debit Cards via Segpay, SEPA Instant banking (EU), local bank rails (LATAM), and NOWPayments cryptocurrency gateway (USDT TRC20/Polygon, USDC, BTC).

---

## 🔮 The "Warm Paywall" & Synergy Engine (Anti-Situationship)
- **100% Free Member Matching**: Free swiping, radar discovery, unlimited messaging, and AI Dating Coach assistance. Zero upfront cold paywalls to view likes.
- **8-Level Chemistry Meter**: Progressive RPG-style synergy tracking that advances with conversation momentum (Level 1 Undefined to Level 8 Soulmate).
- **Match-Gated Creator Discovery**: Members must match or reach Chemistry Level 4 before accessing paid creator options, ensuring high mutual affinity and slashing subscriber churn.

---

## 🛡️ Safety, Privacy & Regulatory Compliance
- **Face Blur Encryption**: Creators and members can obscure their faces on public feeds, selectively unblurring only for Level 4 Chemistry connections or VIP subscribers.
- **Biometric 3D Liveness Verification**: Powered by DIDIT Zero-Knowledge Identity Gateway (`verify.didit.me`) and Sightengine AI.
- **Zero PII & Document Storage**: Biometric checks are executed via zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP eIDAS 2.0 / Privado ID / zkPass). No passport or national ID copies are stored on platform servers.
- **18 U.S.C. § 2257 Custody**: Full compliance with federal and European content safety records; strict zero-tolerance policy against non-consensual content and underage access.
- **DRM Web Sweeper**: Automated continuous web crawling to detect unauthorized media leaks and automatically file DMCA takedown notices.

---

## 🌍 Key Hubs & Geographies
- **European Union**: Spain (HQ in Alicante, Madrid, Barcelona), France (Paris), United Kingdom (London).
- **Latin America**: Colombia (Medellín soft launch hub, Bogotá, Cali).
- **North America**: United States (Miami, New York, Los Angeles).
